relationships.subject: contralateral OFC delta power
relationships.evidence_quote: Common for all participants, contralateral OFC delta power was consistently more important than contralateral ACC delta power to decoding chronic pain NRS

relationships.subject: anterior cingulate cortex
relationships.evidence_quote: Acute pain decoding was supported more by ACC activity.

key_findings: Intracranial OFC LFP power predicts chronic neuropathic pain state in four patients (LDA AUC 0.67-0.85).
Chronic pain decoding relied on sustained OFC power changes whereas acute pain decoding relied more on transient ACC changes.
